providers.note: Sonnet 5.5 and both Haiku offerings have plain, signed-thinking tool, cache, cut, instruction, effort and rejection captures. Signed Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 tool rounds preserve thinking signatures; signed Haiku 4.5 replay answers. MiMo-seed continuation on Sonnet returns 400. Some initial conditional rows were omitted because their source had no thinking or no partial content; signed repeats cover the central behavior. Four optional seed variants were unnecessary.

The replacement token-plan key works on the Singapore host. Messages answers with api-key, Authorization Bearer and x-api-key; Chat answers with Authorization Bearer and api-key. The pay-as-you-go Messages host returned 401 with this key, and its Chat host returned 401 with the old key. Messages produced native thinking and tool_use blocks but no signature in its tool seed; it accepted tool replay with missing or empty signature and accepted a Sonnet signature. Chat produced reasoning_content and a genuine tool call; its stream includes final usage. Messages 5m and 1h marked reads reported 1664 cache_read_input_tokens; Chat implicit, explicit and no-options reads each reported 1152 cached_tokens. On 36 shared completed case names, Messages answered 31 and Chat 29; only Messages accepted effort xhigh and max. Messages covers more of this tested matrix, while the formats expose different native fields. Two Chat streams ended read-failed without terminal markers and are retained without retry.

Muse Spark 1.1 Chat matrix is captured. The cut rows without an observed reasoning_content source cannot be replayed. Native reasoning token counts exist, while reasoning text is private in these samples. Parameters accepted on 200 may be ignored; acceptance alone does not prove semantic effect. Original JSON/SSE bytes and actual tool calls and replay are retained.
